installation.reason: Contexts, schemas, controller documents, signed A/H/O/S/D fixtures and status lists are pinned and verify in TypeScript and Python. The I1-I4 evaluators (protection, status, authority routes, support, claim mapping and coverage, conformity) and the current-reliance time rules are implemented, with a cross-language parity vector; an independent transformation vector is still required before selection.

carrierAndSchema.statusListCarrier: BitstringStatusListCredential with the VCDM 2.0 context only
carrierAndSchema.recognitionCarrier: RecognizedEntityCredential with the VCDM 2.0 context and https://vc4qi.example/contexts/recognized-entities/draft-20261112, a stand-in for the unpublished W3C Recognized Entities context (Working Draft of 12 November 2026); the main scopes are carried in registration (mainScope is an RM binding extension term)
carrierAndSchema.appointmentCarrier: VerifiableAuthorisationForTrustChain with the VCDM 2.0 and RM v1 contexts, in the shape of EBSI's root trust-chain credential (@cef-ebsi/vcdm2.0-trust-model-schema 2.0.0; VCDM 2.0 Example 28): credentialSubject.permissionFor (schemaId, types, jurisdiction) and a termsOfUse TrustFrameworkPolicy (trustFramework, policyId, legalBasis). The RM v1 context defines these terms with the issuer-dependent IRIs EBSI's examples expand to; EBSI's reservedAttributeId and registry status are replaced by a Bitstring Status List
carrierAndSchema.decimalEncoding: JSON strings typed xsd:decimal for every quantity, bound and uncertainty

cardinality.authorizingReferenceSelection: by-the-type-each-named-credential-resolves-to, per route; a named credential that cannot be read leaves it not_established; several of one type not_established

discoveryAndIntegrity.digestCarrier: digestSRI on the termsOfUse or evidence entry that names the credential (VCDM 2.0 section 5.3)
discoveryAndIntegrity.recognitionReferences: only a RecognizedEntityCredential that a grant references from its own termsOfUse (a RecognitionPolicy entry whose id is the recognition, with its digest); issuer.recognizedIn may mirror it and must then name the same credential; recognitions supplied by the holder but not referenced, discovery through issuer.recognizedIn alone and identifier-based discovery are unsupported
discoveryAndIntegrity.appointmentReferences: only a VerifiableAuthorisationForTrustChain that a grant references from its own termsOfUse (an IssuedUnderPolicy entry whose id resolves to that type, with its digest), followed only by a verifier whose profile anchors the appointer for bindingRules.appointment.appointerPurpose; EBSI's registry lookup (parentAccreditation and rootAuthorisation URLs into the Trusted Issuers Registry) is unsupported
discoveryAndIntegrity.independentGrantBinding: unsupported: authority is recognized only through termsOfUse IssuedUnderPolicy entries on the credential chain (the entry's id is the grant); an authenticated grant found by other means establishes nothing (not_established); a RecognitionPolicy reference never establishes authority

rules: A grantee equals the producer exercising certificate issuance and scope maintenance.
O issuer and grantee equal that producer and O is contained by A.
S issuer equals H laboratory grantee.
Commissioning a study grants no laboratory competence.

scopeAndMapping.conceptHierarchy: skos:broader assertions in broader, applied transitively: a scope record's matrix, form or property covers every narrower concept (an accreditation for non-ferrous metals and alloys and element contents contains arsenic in CuZn39Pb3 discs); methods and quantity kinds are exact; labels are never compared; malformed entries are ignored and never widen a scope
scopeAndMapping.methodSuccessionInterpretation: verifier-profile mapping.methodSuccession: accept-successor | require-extension | none (none leaves a revised method not_established at gate 4)
scopeAndMapping.claimCoverage: the selected result, mapped at gate 4, must lie in one complete record of the route's own scope credential (O for operational-scope, A for direct-accreditation); no fallback to a parent grant
scopeAndMapping.conformity: verifier-profile requirements and decision rules, evaluated at gate 6 only after the claim is authorized; exact arithmetic reported in the requirement's unit

routesAndRestrictions.recognition: a grant issuer that is not a configured anchor for the purpose is accepted only through a usable, unsuspended recognition the grant names in a RecognitionPolicy, whose issuer is an anchor for the recognizer purpose and whose subject is the grant issuer, recognized by its issuer to perform the required action in force at the activity time, with the purpose's main scope (activity and normative document, exact) in its registration; a recognition of another body or without that main scope contradicts; an issuer.recognizedIn that names another credential contradicts; a missing recognition, entry or time is not_established; recognition never establishes authority or QI scope

installedGlobalRestrictions.accreditation-suspension: every usable anchor-issued RmpAccreditation of the certificate issuer reached through the target's termsOfUse references, on any route, must carry a fresh issuer suspension status (Bitstring Status List, statusPurpose suspension) with its bit clear; missing or unreadable suspension status is not_established; unusable or unreferenced credentials are not restrictions

routesAndRestrictions.unusedAlternativeFailures: diagnostic-only: only the target and the credentials on the selected route and support chains decide the request

protectionTimeAndResolution.status: authenticated-current-revocation-status-required-for-A-O-D-S-H; suspension entries on accreditations are read only by the accreditation-suspension restriction
protectionTimeAndResolution.statusMechanism: W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0: multibase base64url GZIP encodedList, bounded decompression
protectionTimeAndResolution.freshness: verifier-profile maxAgeSeconds from the status list validFrom, judged at the activity time asked about; no default
protectionTimeAndResolution.historicalReliance: status at an earlier activity time only from a status list of the same issuer in force and fresh at that time (kept, dated lists); a later list cannot establish it; no archive discovery
